notes.title: Big Update for my Big Birthday
notes.notes:
Hey hey I turn 40 years old this week. As I do with every birthday I put all my games on sale. 
Check out these deals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657439/d783691f55f60e8f809bc1cf42f2ab5edc901d4b.gif


 Return of the Zombie King - 50% off
 1 Screen Platformer: 83% off


Quality of life update 

I also decided as a special birthday present to update 1 Screen Platformer with a ton of quality of life improvements. 

Here they are 

 Update 1.40 (You get it? 40? Heh this old man still got it kids.)
 Leaderboards! I don’t know why I didn’t add this earlier, I have a damn speed running game. It took me a while to implement but they are in there. Go hurry and get your name up on the leaderboard before the rest of the speedrunners discover this and figure out how to beat my game in -1 minutes. 
 Fall through: When you are on a 1-way platform you can now push the down arrow and you will fall through. Why didn’t I do this earlier? I don’t know, I was being a snob. When I started making this game I was thinking “A perfect platformer should have as few mechanics as possible.”  But now I am 40 and I am like nah I am getting too old to be ideologically pure. Let them have their fun. Go crazy kids, drop through as many floors as you want, and then go grab me a beer.
 Optional resolutions: I added a selectable option for Full Screen, Windowed 1920x1080 and Windowed 960x540. Now you can text your snapchat tik toks in one window while playing my game in the other. Kids you are so good at your multi-tasking. If you want ultra wide screen I might do that but I wasn’t sure if anyone really wanted that. So comment below if you do and I MIGHT do it.
 No window focus = No Input. This one is just for me. I am sometimes playing 1 Screen Platformer then switch over to type something up and notice that my game was listening to every key input. No MORE! If you switch to a different window you will no longer jump into that lava pit.


Now for the bad news. 

I was hoping to get a build of 1 Screen Platformer Prologue out to you kids as a special birthday present but guess what? We got a pandemic on our hands and day care isn’t exactly open for business so I gotta be a game developer / preschool teacher. My 3 year old takes priority over video game making so things are going to take a bit longer. 

If you want to know when it is coming out subscribe to my newsletter here:
http://returntoadventuremountain.com/community

What did you get me?

What me? You want to get me something? No way?
Ok here is what you can do. 
[olist]
 Go leave a review on one of my games. Doesn’t have to be a good one. Does have to be an honest one. Write something you liked, something you didn’t like for every one of my games you own. That would make me so happy. Here are the games 
Return of the Zombie King AND 
1 Screen Platformer
 Wishlist 1 Screen Platformer 2 and 1 Screen Platformer Prologue
[/olist]

notes.title: Christmas is over update :(
notes.notes:
Alright! I hope you all had a good holiday but all fun times must come to an end. The Christmas mode was a blast and I heard from so many of you that you enjoyed collecting those presents. 

But keep your head up. Holiday season 2020 is just around the corner and there will always be some fun new mode then too.

While I was taking down the decorations in 1 Screen Platformer I also fixed up a few bugs

The Gun Miner exploding blocks would sometimes explode the wrong color of debris, I fixed that.
Vez's level didn't have music for some reason. Added it back in.
The Gun Miner normal level had a few items that were from the Hard Mode of the level. I swapped them out.

notes.title: Free Update: New Playable Character
notes.notes:
I have added a new playable character to the game. 

GUN MINER!

Gun Miner is a mysterious and unstoppable figure who caries with them the Void-Blaster Riffle. One shot from this short-range weapon and just about any block will instantly disintegrate.

Don't want to jump over that block? Blast it! 

Want to drop down to the next floor so you don't have to go all the way around? Blast it!

With the Void-Blaster there is no longer a designated path through the level. You can do it in just about any order. Watch this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657439/bb129c0361adc5a2afb55dc28d0e21541070c7a1.gif

Skip huge chunks of the level just by blasting through it.

But be careful!

Sometimes walls were there to keep traps in place. With no wall, some traps can wander freely through the level...like this blue pounding block.

It was once safe to stand there. Not any more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657439/dcccde69f33ae54bcc9101b497039c80fd74ec56.gif

I can't wait to see what you do with this new character. There are so many different ways to play the level now there will definitely be some world records set. 

Best of all, the new Gun Miner character and levels are completely free. Please enjoy them. There are 2 difficulties AND the Christmas mode. 

1 Screen Platformer now has 5 playable characters. It might be a small game but it always has room to grow.

notes.title: Update 1.2 - The VEZ Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657439/540483bfac19130760fb601660ac9aeadc929b10.png

Holly heck I thought this was going to be, you know, a little patch that kind of fixes some little things. But whoa boy it was not. There was a lot that went into this one. 

Note: To get this update sometimes you have to close steam and then open it again and it will download. ALSO if the game immediately crashes when you open it, uninstall the game from steam then reinstall (your level progress will still be there, don't worry.) You will know you have the right one if you get a red splash screen and on the main menu there is a 1.2 in the bottom right corner.

1) First off, the big one. The Vez levels are now a lot easier. I know. I watch the stats. Nobody gets very far in his level. So I cleaned up the nav orbs so they are in a much more manageable spot. Get to it. If you gave up on Vez, try it again I think you will have a much better time. 
2) I added music! I thought the subtle thumping of the giant stone heads of azergoth, and the wailing guns hurtling hunks of hot lava would be enough of a soundscape, but no. Everyone was really wanting to have a sound track to listen to while they died over and over again. So I give you the new backing track: It is called “BushWeek.” Great song. Terrible Title. I would have called it “Theme of a 1980s action film where the team comes together and starts build a totally boss tank out of metal scraps hanging around the warehouse so they can infiltrate the bad guy’s secret headquarters” But that’s why I don’t get to name song titles. Try it out on any of the levels.


Here are a bunch of other changes I don’t think you would notice unless I told you about them: 

 Buttons are bigger on the main menu. Sweet change right? I know you were complaining about that Carl. Well here you go stop bugging me about tiny buttons. Carl!
 Actually the select difficulty is now on the right side of the screen so that we don’t cover up the character names. Who put that menu there before? 
 See this little icon. https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657439/73b5729e9d6e5098ae8a6494300f99c5d6bbdb38.png FULL!CONTROLLER!SUPPORT! Seems like a minor achievement. But that little 16x16px badass cost me 49 hours worth of coding to completely rewrite my GUI code. I sure hope you enjoy it and use your controller a whole lot.
 There is now a big red title screen with my big fat name on it.
 Added a sign right at the start of x97c’s level that says “MUST GET 100% fog.” A lot of people were playing thinking they had to get to the end and then at the end it was like NOPE! go back and get all the fog. Sorry for not telling you at the beginning. Hope this clarifies things. 
 Debug is no longer toggled by just pushing “T”. Too many muggles were just doing that by accident and then emailing me asking what was with all the boxes. Now to view hitboxes you have to go into settings enable debug mode. Then in the game pushing “T” will turn on the debug mode.
 Added keyboard menus to the mailing list signup page when you use a controller so that you dont have to get up walk over to your computer and type in your email information. All you have to do is smash the action button while in a text field and the keyboard will popup.
 You now get a little “Are you sure?” Message when you try to clear your data. No slip ups this time. 
 There was a bug where if you just walked up and touched that timed door that protects the golden skull it would just open. The door was totally unlocked! You didn’t even need to hit the switch. I am surprised nobody figured it out.


That is all for now Scamps! As always email me if you have questions or post in the forums. I always answer them. IAMCHRISZUKOWSKi [AAAATTTTT] gmail DOT COM!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.10
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32657439/b7422dd01dd80646e849d63d997b56ef625ab5e8.png

I patched 1 Screen Platformer. Thank you so much to everyone who has emailed me a support note or has left a comment in our Discord. I take your feedback VERY seriously. Here is what has changed:

 Fixed the Let's Play Badly(TM) shortcut. Like the Kessel run this was a shortcut that was a little... lets say illegal. Double-jump capable characters could use it to bypass the entire game. I needed to brick up that wall. Let me tell you nothing is getting through there now. If you want to see the discovery of it check out this excellent video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SqYMjh3quiY&feature=youtu.be
 Fixed the glitch just above the flame plates where you couldn’t fall back down through the opening. You would just float there like "What now?" 
 Made the sound of the intro drums quieter. True story that sound actually scared my wife one time when I forgot to mute my laptop and she was watching TV. Don’t know why it took so long to quiet it. I guess I felt like I had to go big or go home. I went big and I am sorry. I will add volume control to the whole game soon but that takes more time so I will update that in a future patch.
 Vez Specific: The stars from the little nav orbs were updated so they weigh as much as 100 fairy kisses, 22 dancing angels, and have the heaviness of a maiden's heart on a fresh summer morning... which means they weigh nothing so they do not trigger the trampolines. 
 Vez Specific: His hitbox is now the exact same as Nadia’s. I gave him the wrong hit box in the launch of the game. This will make it MUCH MUCH easier to play as him. If you gave up on him try it again, you would be amazed at what 2 fewer pixels can do.
 I added hit box visualizations to the spinning orbs so you can practice your circle jumping. Just press "T" to see them.
 I changed the sound of laser blasters. On some machines the sound would produce a high-pitched whine that someone described as a mosquito. So I tried a new sound effect.
 That is all I have for this update. There are two bigger game crashing bugs when you beat the game as Vez or Subject x95c. I am working on it! I just wanted to make these changes first because I know they cause a lot of pain for people day to day.
